headline: Health/medical YMYL sites show volatile recovery pattern post-July algorithm hit

SERP & Algorithm Signals.what_happened: Health/medical YMYL sites see sharp July drops, partial recovery | 医疗健康类YMYL网站7月暴跌后部分恢复
SERP & Algorithm Signals.why_it_matters: YMYL垂直领域持续经历极端波动性，表明Google对医疗内容的质量评估仍在剧烈调整，影响内容策略稳定性
SERP & Algorithm Signals.evidence: Glenn Gabe data research: multiple independent health/medical sites showing matching pattern of July 8 drop followed by recent recovery
SERP & Algorithm Signals.evidence_detail: Gabe tracked at least two additional health/medical sites with identical volatility pattern: significant traffic drop beginning July 8, then recent recovery. This follows earlier pattern of YMYL sites being hit during core updates. No sample size or traffic numbers disclosed; pattern identified through cross-site observation of Search Console data trends. Caveat: correlation with specific update unconfirmed, recovery may be partial or temporary.
SERP & Algorithm Signals.what_to_do: 监控YMYL页面流量波动，记录恢复节点与内容变更的对应关系

SERP & Algorithm Signals.evidence: Glenn Gabe observation: specific health site 'huge drop on 7/8' with visible recovery trajectory in Search Console data
SERP & Algorithm Signals.evidence_detail: Individual site case showing dramatic July 8 traffic collapse followed by recovery pattern. Site noted as 'seeming to recover' — recovery incomplete at time of observation. No domain disclosed, no traffic volume or percentage change specified. Single-site observation without comparative baseline; value lies in temporal alignment with other reported cases suggesting coordinated algorithmic event.
